story_clusters.headline: What senior RSS, BJP leaders may be trying to convey to BJP through their remarks on youth protests
story_clusters.summary: Senior leaders from the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) have made public comments on recent youth protests in India. These comments include remarks by Mohan Bhagwat, Murli Manohar Joshi, and Muralidhar Rao. The BJP has also organized protests at Jantar Mantar, including one against the Punjab education minister over alleged paper leaks.

articles.title: Parliament clears stricter anti-paper leak Bill with harsher penalties, fast-track courts
articles.summary: Parliament has approved amendments to India's anti-paper leak law, significantly tightening penalties for examination fraud and expanding enforcement powers. The revised legislation introduces special fast-track courts, empowers the Centre to set up a dedicated investigation task force, and broadens the scope of offences covered. The government says the changes aim to protect the integrity of public examinations and restore confidence among millions of students appearing for competitive tests.

articles.title: How health insurance portability is becoming a trap for policyholders
articles.summary: Health insurance portability in India, designed to benefit policyholders, is being misused due to sales incentives despite regulatory prohibitions. The weakest link is the advice from intermediaries facilitating policy switches, which often lacks accountability. The article highlights how this system, meant to empower consumers, may instead trap them due to poor oversight.
articles.raw_summary: Portability, a framework designed to benefit policyholders, is increasingly being driven by sales incentives, despite regulations prohibiting it. Consequently, the weakest link becomes the advice provided by the intermediary facilitating the switch, often with little accountability.

articles.title: How AI Is powering India’s next generation of smart electricity grids
articles.summary: India's renewable capacity is scaling at a pace few grids have had to accommodate. But solar and wind are not dispatchable in the way coal and gas are, and a grid built around predictable baseload generation struggles to absorb large, variable inflows without instability. AI-based load forecasting and demand-response systems are what actually allow a distribution network to integrate high volumes of renewable energy reliably.

The research suggests that supporting those in financial distress could help preserve cognitive health. The findings underscore the need for policies addressing economic inequality and its health impacts.

Providing support for those in financial distress could play a vital role in preserving cognitive health in the future.

articles.title: A deep dive with Rs 84,084 crore scheme for offshore oil and gas exploration
articles.summary: The Cabinet approved an ₹84,084-crore scheme for offshore oil and gas exploration. This National Offshore Exploration Scheme, Samudra Manthan, will run until 2030-31. This initiative seeks to de-risk exploration for companies and increase production.
